author: XamOps Team
description: Seed manifest for 26 production-ready Python automation scripts. The bulk-import task (4.6) reads each entry, loads the referenced .py file from the classpath at codeBaseDir/codeFile, and persists a DevOpsScript plus its ScriptParameter rows. Every script uses argparse for its CLI, the relevant cloud SDK (boto3 / azure-sdk / google-cloud) or the standard library, and proper error handling. Customizable values use the {{PARAMETER_NAME}} placeholder syntax embedded in module-level string literals so files remain syntactically valid for py_compile. Covers AWS, Azure, GCP, data processing, and monitoring automation. Implements REQ-2.1.1, REQ-2.1.2, REQ-2.1.3, REQ-2.2.1.

scripts.name: EC2 Instance Manager
scripts.description: Lists, starts, stops, or reboots EC2 instances in a region using boto3, resolving 'all' or a comma-separated set of instance IDs.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, boto3 installed, and AWS credentials with EC2 describe/start/stop/reboot permissions.

parameters.name: AWS_REGION
parameters.label: AWS Region
parameters.description: AWS region the instances live in, e.g. us-east-1.

parameters.name: INSTANCE_IDS
parameters.label: Instance IDs
parameters.description: Comma-separated instance IDs, or 'all' to target every instance.

parameters.name: ACTION
parameters.label: Action
parameters.description: Operation to perform on the instances.

scripts.name: S3 Lifecycle Management
scripts.description: Applies a lifecycle policy to an S3 bucket: transitions objects to STANDARD_IA after N days and expires them after M days.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, boto3 installed, and AWS credentials with s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration on the target bucket.

parameters.name: AWS_REGION
parameters.label: AWS Region
parameters.description: AWS region of the bucket, e.g. us-east-1.

parameters.name: BUCKET_NAME
parameters.label: S3 Bucket Name
parameters.description: Target S3 bucket to apply the lifecycle policy to.

parameters.name: TRANSITION_DAYS
parameters.label: Transition Days
parameters.description: Days before objects transition to STANDARD_IA.

parameters.name: EXPIRATION_DAYS
parameters.label: Expiration Days
parameters.description: Days before objects expire (must exceed transition days).

scripts.name: CloudWatch Log Analyzer
scripts.description: Scans a CloudWatch Logs log group over a time window, counts events matching a filter pattern, and prints recent matches.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, boto3 installed, and AWS credentials with logs:FilterLogEvents permission.

parameters.name: AWS_REGION
parameters.label: AWS Region
parameters.description: AWS region of the log group, e.g. us-east-1.

parameters.name: LOG_GROUP
parameters.label: Log Group
parameters.description: CloudWatch Logs log group name to scan.

parameters.name: HOURS_BACK
parameters.label: Hours Back
parameters.description: How many hours of history to scan.

parameters.name: FILTER_PATTERN
parameters.label: Filter Pattern
parameters.description: CloudWatch filter pattern, e.g. ERROR.

scripts.name: AWS Unused Resources Finder
scripts.description: Scans a region for cost-wasting unused resources: unattached EBS volumes, unassociated Elastic IPs, and stopped EC2 instances.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, boto3 installed, and AWS credentials with EC2 describe permissions.

parameters.name: AWS_REGION
parameters.label: AWS Region
parameters.description: AWS region to scan, e.g. us-east-1.

scripts.name: EC2 Cost Report
scripts.description: Produces an AWS cost report using the Cost Explorer API for a trailing number of days, grouped by service.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, boto3 installed, Cost Explorer enabled, and credentials with ce:GetCostAndUsage permission.

parameters.name: AWS_REGION
parameters.label: AWS Region
parameters.description: Region for the Cost Explorer client, e.g. us-east-1.

parameters.name: DAYS_BACK
parameters.label: Days Back
parameters.description: Number of trailing days to include in the report.

scripts.name: IAM Key Rotation Auditor
scripts.description: Audits IAM users' access keys and flags any active key older than a maximum allowed age to enforce key-rotation policy.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, boto3 installed, and AWS credentials with iam:ListUsers and iam:ListAccessKeys permissions.

parameters.name: MAX_KEY_AGE_DAYS
parameters.label: Max Key Age (days)
parameters.description: Maximum acceptable access-key age in days before it is flagged.

scripts.name: RDS Snapshot Manager
scripts.description: Creates a manual RDS snapshot for a DB instance and prunes manual snapshots older than a retention window.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, boto3 installed, and AWS credentials with RDS snapshot create/describe/delete permissions.

parameters.name: AWS_REGION
parameters.label: AWS Region
parameters.description: AWS region of the DB instance, e.g. us-east-1.

parameters.name: DB_INSTANCE_ID
parameters.label: DB Instance ID
parameters.description: RDS DB instance identifier to snapshot.

parameters.name: RETENTION_DAYS
parameters.label: Retention (days)
parameters.description: Days to keep manual snapshots before deletion.

scripts.name: S3 Bucket Size Reporter
scripts.description: Calculates total object count and size for an S3 bucket, optionally scoped to a key prefix, by paginating over object listings.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, boto3 installed, and AWS credentials with s3:ListBucket permission.

parameters.name: AWS_REGION
parameters.label: AWS Region
parameters.description: AWS region of the bucket, e.g. us-east-1.

parameters.name: BUCKET_NAME
parameters.label: S3 Bucket Name
parameters.description: S3 bucket to measure.

parameters.name: PREFIX
parameters.label: Key Prefix
parameters.description: Optional key prefix to scope the report; empty scans the whole bucket.

scripts.name: Azure VM Status Checker
scripts.description: Lists virtual machines in a resource group and reports their power state using the Azure SDK and DefaultAzureCredential.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, azure-identity and azure-mgmt-compute installed, and an authenticated Azure identity with Reader on the resource group.

parameters.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
parameters.label: Subscription ID
parameters.description: Azure subscription ID containing the VMs.

parameters.name: RESOURCE_GROUP
parameters.label: Resource Group
parameters.description: Resource group containing the VMs.

scripts.name: Azure Blob Storage Cleaner
scripts.description: Deletes blobs in an Azure Storage container older than a retention window, with a dry-run mode to preview deletions.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, azure-identity and azure-storage-blob installed, and an identity with Storage Blob Data Contributor on the account.

parameters.name: STORAGE_ACCOUNT
parameters.label: Storage Account
parameters.description: Azure Storage account name.

parameters.name: CONTAINER_NAME
parameters.label: Container Name
parameters.description: Blob container to clean.

parameters.name: RETENTION_DAYS
parameters.label: Retention (days)
parameters.description: Delete blobs older than this many days.

scripts.name: Azure Resource Group Reporter
scripts.description: Reports all resources in an Azure resource group grouped by resource type using the Azure Resource Management SDK.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, azure-identity and azure-mgmt-resource installed, and an identity with Reader on the resource group.

parameters.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
parameters.label: Subscription ID
parameters.description: Azure subscription ID.

parameters.name: RESOURCE_GROUP
parameters.label: Resource Group
parameters.description: Resource group to report on.

scripts.name: Azure Cost Reporter
scripts.description: Queries Azure Cost Management for actual cost over a trailing period for a subscription and prints a daily cost summary.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, azure-identity and azure-mgmt-costmanagement installed, and an identity with Cost Management Reader on the subscription.

parameters.name: SUBSCRIPTION_ID
parameters.label: Subscription ID
parameters.description: Azure subscription ID to report cost for.

parameters.name: DAYS_BACK
parameters.label: Days Back
parameters.description: Number of trailing days to include.

scripts.name: GCP Compute Instance Scheduler
scripts.description: Starts or stops a Google Compute Engine instance to support cost-saving start/stop schedules via cron or Cloud Scheduler.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, google-cloud-compute installed, and Application Default Credentials with compute.instances start/stop permissions.

parameters.name: PROJECT_ID
parameters.label: Project ID
parameters.description: GCP project ID containing the instance.

parameters.name: GCP_ZONE
parameters.label: Zone
parameters.description: Compute Engine zone, e.g. us-central1-a.

parameters.name: INSTANCE_NAME
parameters.label: Instance Name
parameters.description: Name of the instance to manage.

parameters.name: ACTION
parameters.label: Action
parameters.description: Operation to perform on the instance.

scripts.name: GCP BigQuery Cost Analyzer
scripts.description: Analyzes BigQuery query costs over a trailing period from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS, estimating cost from bytes billed per user.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, google-cloud-bigquery installed, and credentials with BigQuery Job User and access to INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS.

parameters.name: PROJECT_ID
parameters.label: Project ID
parameters.description: GCP project ID to analyze.

parameters.name: DAYS_BACK
parameters.label: Days Back
parameters.description: Number of trailing days to analyze.

scripts.name: GCP Cloud Storage Sync
scripts.description: Synchronizes objects from a source GCS bucket to a destination bucket, copying any object missing or changed in the destination.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, google-cloud-storage installed, and credentials with read on the source and write on the destination bucket.

parameters.name: PROJECT_ID
parameters.label: Project ID
parameters.description: GCP project ID for the storage client.

parameters.name: SOURCE_BUCKET
parameters.label: Source Bucket
parameters.description: Source Cloud Storage bucket name.

parameters.name: DEST_BUCKET
parameters.label: Destination Bucket
parameters.description: Destination Cloud Storage bucket name.

scripts.name: GCP Unused Disks Finder
scripts.description: Finds unattached (orphaned) persistent disks in a GCP zone that are no longer in use by any instance to reclaim storage cost.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+, google-cloud-compute installed, and credentials with compute.disks.list permission.

parameters.name: PROJECT_ID
parameters.label: Project ID
parameters.description: GCP project ID to scan.

parameters.name: GCP_ZONE
parameters.label: Zone
parameters.description: Compute Engine zone, e.g. us-central1-a.

scripts.name: CSV to JSON Converter
scripts.description: Converts a delimited CSV file into a JSON array of objects using the header row as keys, with custom delimiter and pretty-print support.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only) and read access to the input CSV file.

parameters.name: INPUT_FILE
parameters.label: Input File
parameters.description: Path to the input CSV file.

parameters.name: OUTPUT_FILE
parameters.label: Output File
parameters.description: Path to write the JSON output.

parameters.name: DELIMITER
parameters.label: Delimiter
parameters.description: Field delimiter character, e.g. ',' or ';'.

scripts.name: JSON to CSV Converter
scripts.description: Converts a JSON array of flat objects into a CSV file, using the union of all keys as the header with missing values left blank.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only) and read access to the input JSON file.

parameters.name: INPUT_FILE
parameters.label: Input File
parameters.description: Path to the input JSON file (array of objects).

parameters.name: OUTPUT_FILE
parameters.label: Output File
parameters.description: Path to write the CSV output.

scripts.name: Log Parser and Aggregator
scripts.description: Parses a log file with a configurable regex, aggregates counts by a named capture group, and writes a JSON summary of the most frequent values.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only) and read access to the target log file.

parameters.name: LOG_PATH
parameters.label: Log Path
parameters.description: Path to the log file to parse.

parameters.name: OUTPUT_FILE
parameters.label: Output File
parameters.description: Path to write the JSON aggregation summary.

parameters.name: LOG_PATTERN
parameters.label: Log Pattern
parameters.description: Regex with a named group 'key' to aggregate on.

scripts.name: Batch File Processor
scripts.description: Walks an input directory for files matching a glob pattern, computes a SHA-256 checksum and size for each, and writes a manifest.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only) and read access to the input directory plus write access to the output directory.

parameters.name: INPUT_DIR
parameters.label: Input Directory
parameters.description: Directory containing files to process.

parameters.name: OUTPUT_DIR
parameters.label: Output Directory
parameters.description: Directory where the manifest is written.

parameters.name: FILE_PATTERN
parameters.label: File Pattern
parameters.description: Glob pattern to match files, e.g. *.txt.

scripts.name: API Endpoint Health Checker
scripts.description: Performs an HTTP health check against an endpoint, asserting the response status code and measuring latency. Exits non-zero on failure for CI or monitoring.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only) and network access to the target endpoint.

parameters.name: API_ENDPOINT
parameters.label: API Endpoint
parameters.description: Full URL to check, e.g. https://api.example.com/health.

parameters.name: TIMEOUT_SECONDS
parameters.label: Timeout (s)
parameters.description: Request timeout in seconds.

parameters.name: EXPECTED_STATUS
parameters.label: Expected Status
parameters.description: Expected HTTP status code, e.g. 200.

scripts.name: Database Connection Validator
scripts.description: Validates connectivity to a database server by opening a TCP socket to the host/port and reporting reachability and latency. Useful as a readiness probe.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only) and network access to the database host and port.

parameters.name: DB_HOST
parameters.label: Database Host
parameters.description: Database hostname or IP.

parameters.name: DB_PORT
parameters.label: Database Port
parameters.description: Database TCP port, e.g. 5432.

parameters.name: DB_NAME
parameters.label: Database Name
parameters.description: Database name (informational, included in output).

parameters.name: DB_USER
parameters.label: Database User
parameters.description: Database user (informational, included in output).

scripts.name: SSL Certificate Expiry Checker
scripts.description: Connects to a host over TLS, reads the server certificate, and reports days until expiry. Exits non-zero if expiry is within a warning threshold.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only) and network access to the target host on the TLS port.

parameters.name: TARGET_HOST
parameters.label: Target Host
parameters.description: Hostname to check, e.g. example.com.

parameters.name: TARGET_PORT
parameters.label: Target Port
parameters.description: TLS port, e.g. 443.

parameters.name: WARN_DAYS
parameters.label: Warn Days
parameters.description: Warn/fail if the certificate expires within this many days.

scripts.name: Multi-Endpoint Monitor
scripts.description: Reads a newline-delimited file of URLs and performs an HTTP health check on each, printing a status table and exiting non-zero if any endpoint is down.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only), an endpoints file with one URL per line, and network access to those URLs.

parameters.name: ENDPOINTS_FILE
parameters.label: Endpoints File
parameters.description: Path to a file with one URL per line.

parameters.name: TIMEOUT_SECONDS
parameters.label: Timeout (s)
parameters.description: Per-request timeout in seconds.

scripts.name: DNS Record Checker
scripts.description: Resolves DNS records for a domain and prints the results, supporting A and AAAA lookups via the standard library with no external dependencies.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only) and DNS resolution access from the host.

parameters.name: DOMAIN_NAME
parameters.label: Domain Name
parameters.description: Domain to resolve, e.g. example.com.

parameters.name: RECORD_TYPE
parameters.label: Record Type
parameters.description: Record family to query.

scripts.name: Port Scanner
scripts.description: Scans a range of TCP ports on a target host and reports which are open. Useful for verifying firewall rules and service exposure on hosts you are authorized to test.
scripts.prerequisites: Python 3.8+ (standard library only) and authorization plus network access to scan the target host.

parameters.name: TARGET_HOST
parameters.label: Target Host
parameters.description: Host to scan, e.g. 10.0.0.5.

parameters.name: PORT_RANGE
parameters.label: Port Range
parameters.description: Inclusive port range as 'start-end', e.g. 1-1024.
